rule: Every user prompt enters StarCi by opening or reusing the host-bound user session before any goal confirmation or work. The mission draft is shown as scopeTable. Its version is activated only by an explicit as-stated user answer; when the original prompt already states and authorizes exactly that table, its message reference is reused as the answer and no routine duplicate question is asked. Correction creates the next draft version; rejection or silence never activates work. Follow-ups, operator attempts, helpers, retries and nested exchanges keep the same host binding. Replan inside the confirmed scope is automatic. A change to goal or scope creates a versioned confirmation; budget and user routes remain typed choices. This communication policy grants no extra effect authority.

language.rule: Every line printed to the person — the goal block, the Operator Result summary, the end-of-turn report, every question and its options — is in the display language the settings name; a new mission records it as mission.language unless the person's own message is plainly in another language, in which case that one is recorded and used. The law of the tree stays English and its mirrors Vietnamese; the display language changes nothing that is validated.

asks.rule: The first prompt opens the draft session before the confirmation is evaluated. Ask goal-confirm only when the prompt itself does not already explicitly authorize the exact versioned scope table. Record the authorizing prompt or answer as sourceRef. Continuations under the same confirmed goal, replans, attempts, helpers and nested exchanges ask nothing. A corrected scope is a new version and is confirmed again. A helper reuses hostBinding and never creates a user session or a goal choice. An approved bank answer may be reused only for the unchanged banked goal version.

reportShapes.delivered: What was delivered and where it is: the head, the served URL or the evidence folder.
reportShapes.blocked-on-you: What the person must decide or change, in one sentence, and what continues without them.
reportShapes.working: What is being done now and the next milestone the person will hear about.

shape: [N/M operator] <done | mismatch | blocked STOP> · <k>/<n> done-when evidenced · <artifact paths> · <next cell | repair | retry>
transitionLog.rule: After every transition preserve this two-line machine record in the session folder ledger. Do not print the dense pair in the root chat. Present the visible outcomePresentation block, then record logged:true. Full outputs and prior failed attempts stay in the session folder.

outcomePresentation.heading: Operator Result
outcomePresentation.rule: Display the exact heading Operator Result, then the compact Step/Status/Result/Next table, then all selected native image embeds, then short details and links to original images and full evidence. An accepted matched receipt means the operator finished its check, not that its subject passed: preserve the actual verdict, limitations and dry-run, reuse/no-op or rollback mode in Result. Use a recorded next cell, an explicit repair action, or an honest planned-chain completion; never infer goal success from matched. Keep raw hashes and long paths out of the summary table and escape pipes and line breaks. For accepted done receipts call the renderer after the existing evidence and operator gates. Blocked, waiting and mismatched attempts retain their actual status, useful evidence and repair step under the same visible heading without claiming accepted completion. Do not duplicate the internal dense transition pair in chat. Images are native embeds followed by original-image links, never a filename or link-only substitute. Never expose credentials, tokens or private runtime dumps. The operator contract and mode determine the useful result; full artifacts and immutable records remain linked.
